title: Micah Bible Quiz - Chapter 7
description: Ten questions on Micah 7: the godly man who has perished, waiting for the God of salvation, and sins cast into the sea.

questions.text: What does the speaker compare himself to at the start of the chapter?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:1 says he is like one who gathers the summer fruits, as gleanings of the vineyard, with no cluster of grapes to eat.

answers.text: A shepherd who has lost his flock
One who gathers the summer fruits
A watchman asleep on the wall
A traveler in a dry land

questions.text: What does the speaker's soul desire to eat?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:1 says his soul desires to eat the early fig.

questions.text: Who has perished out of the earth, according to verse 2?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:2 says the godly man has perished out of the earth and there is no one upright among men.

questions.text: What do the ruler and the judge ask for?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:3 says the ruler and judge ask for a bribe, and the powerful man dictates the evil desire of his soul.

questions.text: Whom does verse 5 say not to trust?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:5 says, "Don't trust in a neighbor."

questions.text: According to verse 6, who rises up against her mother?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:6 says the daughter rises up against her mother, and the daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

questions.text: What will Yahweh be to the speaker when he sits in darkness?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:8 says that when he sits in darkness, Yahweh will be a light to him.

questions.text: From which lands does verse 12 say they will come in that day?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:12 says in that day they will come from Assyria and the cities of Egypt, and from Egypt even to the River.

answers.text: From Assyria and the cities of Egypt
From Babylon and the coasts of Tyre
From Moab and the hills of Edom
From Cush and the land of Nimrod

questions.text: What will the nations lick like a serpent?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:17 says they will lick the dust like a serpent and come trembling out of their dens.

questions.text: Where does verse 19 say all their sins will be cast?
questions.explanation: Micah 7:19 says he will tread their iniquities under foot and cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.

answers.text: Into the depths of the sea
